attributes.title: Sun, Sand & CE Cruise 2027
attributes.series: Sun, Sand & CE Cruise (WDA and Michigan Dental Association)
attributes.cme_provider: Wisconsin Dental Association / Michigan Dental Association
attributes.summary:
The Wisconsin Dental Association and the Michigan Dental Association run a CE cruise aboard the Harmony of the Seas from January 16 to 23, 2027, with stops in St. Maarten, Puerto Rico and CocoCay. Sessions are held in the mornings only, and attendees can bring their team or family.

The program offers up to 9 CE credits. CE registration is $359 for association member dentists (in-state or out-of-state), $459 for non-member dentists and $299 for staff. The departure port is not stated on the CE page.
